title: Setup → OAuth applications: Rotate Client Secret's confirmation says the old secret stops working immediately, while its result dialog speaks of a grace period
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-23** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

This card is the second of the finding's two halves. The first, the approvals Override Reassign copy, is a separate objectui card.

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Setup → Advanced → OAuth applications → an application → Rotate Client Secret.
- **Actual:** the confirmation says "The previous secret will stop working immediately". The result dialog then says "Update every integration before the previous secret's grace period ends." At most one of them can be true.
- **Expected:** both texts state what rotation actually does to the previous secret: an immediate cut-off, or a grace period with its length.
- **Evidence:** [`40-advanced-oauth-rotated.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/40-advanced-oauth-rotated.png).
- **class:** a. **Reach:** every admin.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `packages/platform-objects` `sys-oauth-application.object.ts:186` and `:193`, the action's two texts.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 1 hit in objectstack, 5 in objectui, none on point. **New.**
